name: BYOV Stack
tagline: The stack BYOV itself is built on — start compliant, stay shippable.

scaffold.title: Create the app from the blueprint
scaffold.detail: Copy the file tree in stacks/byov-stack/blueprint.md into a new repository — same configs, same scripts, same gates.

scaffold.title: Install dependencies
scaffold.detail: Use a clean install so versions match the manifest.

scaffold.title: Configure the environment
scaffold.detail: Copy the example env file and fill in local values. Never commit secrets.

scaffold.title: Run the dev server
scaffold.detail: Pick a free port — the Control Plane itself uses 3014.

scaffold.title: Keep the gates green
scaffold.detail: Every change passes unit tests, lint, typecheck and the production build before it ships.
scaffold.command: npm run test:unit && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build

scaffold.title: Connect to the Control Plane
scaffold.detail: Register the app in BYOV and connect from your coding tool (Muse, Codex, Claude). One-command client setup lands on the roadmap; until then register the repo manually.

scaffold.title: Ship to an approved node
scaffold.detail: Deploy only to admin-approved targets. First supported kind: self-hosted Coolify.

starter.note: Versioned starter repos and one-command scaffolding arrive with the BYOV client.
